Sam fragments, when present in Image 1, are blue-gray suit pieces of fallen Sam, not floor, a platform or boots. Only paint characters and partial pieces actually present in Image 1.
Output one 1024x1024 PNG with genuine soft antialiased alpha, no painted background. Maintain the whole original cel layout with generous transparent margin around and between all components, approximately the same framing as Image 1. Do not copy pixel stair steps or use a hard source silhouette mask. Frame costume124_1921, original complete extent 62 by 56 pixels. Every tiny gesture and attachment point belongs to this exact phase.
